2607.09530.title: FreyaTTS Technical Report
2607.09530.paper_summary: We introduce Freya-TTS, a compact, tokenizer-free, Turkish-first text-to-speech model designed for highly reliable and efficient conversational synthesis. Freya-TTS is a 183.2M-parameter non-autoregressive conditional flow-matching Diffusion Transformer (DiT) that operates in the frozen continuous latent space of AudioVAE2 (16 kHz encode, 48 kHz decode), allowing the model to focus its capacity on text-to-latent mapping while inheriting high-quality 48 kHz reconstruction. We advance the framework along three key dimensions: (1) rule-free end-to-end modeling from a 92-symbol Turkish character vocabulary without a phonemizer, grapheme-to-phoneme frontend, or discrete speech tokenizer; (2) non-autoregressive parallel denoising, which predicts the entire latent sequence simultaneously over a predicted duration; and (3) a production-oriented two-stage post-training recipe consisting of single-speaker voice locking and short-utterance coverage, improving speaker consistency and robustness on short inputs. On the Freya-TR-Eval benchmark, Freya-TTS achieves a band-matched word error rate (WER) of 8.0% and character error rate (CER) of 3.0%, outperforming substantially larger open-source systems while using a fraction of their parameters. The model achieves a real-time factor of 0.11 on consumer GPUs and runs faster than real time on a laptop CPU, making it well suited for resource-constrained edge deployment. We release the model weights, training and inference code, and evaluation benchmark under the Apache-2.0 license.
2607.09530.paper_summary_zh: 我們介紹 Freya-TTS，這是一個緊湊的、無需分詞器的、以土耳其語為首的文本轉語音模型，旨在實現高度可靠和高效的對話合成。Freya-TTS 是一個擁有 183.2M 參數的非自回歸條件流匹配擴散Transformer（DiT），它在 AudioVAE2 的凍結連續潛在空間中運作（16 kHz 編碼，48 kHz 解碼），使模型能夠將其能力集中於文本到潛在的映射，同時繼承高質量的 48 kHz 重建。我們在三個關鍵維度上推進了這一框架：（1）從 92 符號的土耳其字符詞彙進行無規則的端到端建模，無需音素化器、圖形到音素前端或離散語音分詞器；（2）非自回歸的並行去噪，能夠在預測的持續時間內同時預測整個潛在序列；以及（3）一個以生產為導向的兩階段後訓練方案，包括單一說話者的聲音鎖定和短語音覆蓋，提高了短輸入的說話者一致性和穩健性。在 Freya-TR-Eval 基準上，Freya-TTS 實現了 8.0% 的帶匹配詞錯誤率（WER）和 3.0% 的字符錯誤率（CER），在使用其參數的一小部分的情況下，顯著超越了更大規模的開源系統。該模型在消費者 GPU 上達到 0.11 的實時因子，並在筆記本 CPU 上運行速度超過實時，這使其非常適合資源受限的邊緣部署。我們根據 Apache-2.0 許可證發布模型權重、訓練和推理代碼以及評估基準。
